title: Loop observes a failed command and recovers
prompt:
First, in its own bash tool call, run: test -e {{workdir}}/definitely-missing-{{token}}
Observe that failure. Then use a later bash tool call to create {{workdir}}/recovered.txt containing exactly RECOVERED_{{token}} followed by a newline, and read it back before finishing.

title: Loop carries observed state across separate edits
prompt: Use separate bash tool calls for these steps: (1) create {{workdir}}/log.txt with START_{{token}} and read it; (2) append END_{{token}} and read the complete file. Finish only after the second readback.
